content.description: First full-structure spec: compliant cars plus a small car space-seeker; motorcycles split into normal, slow lane-centre and space-seeking (custom1) riders; illegal-left riders in moto_violator; red running, early start and space seeking via TraCI rules.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car (headway 0.35 s), M3/share/car (0.004) and M6 car times: near-default car-following and no native red running, since observed car red running is almost nil.
Targets M8/car (wrong-lane share 0.068) and F2 wrong_lane: a minority of cars may use an adjacent lane when the queue is long; share 0.1 keeps the car-level wrong-lane share near the observed value.

Targets M1/moto (headway 0.30 s), M4/overshoot_share (0.62) and M5/moto_density (0.052 veh/m2): short tau and small minGap/minGapLat with compact alignment and active lateral filtering pack motorcycles in the queue and let them pass the stop line.
Targets M6/approach and junction moto times (behaviour 10): a lower speedFactor gives slow riders that keep the lane centre, raising approach times toward the observed 36-54 s for s/l movements.

Targets M8/moto (wrong-lane share 0.249), M10a (0.56 sidewalk riders per cycle) and M4: riders eligible for queue_space_seeking, with stronger lateral aggressiveness and impatience; share 0.3 scales the per-rider probabilities to the observed overall shares.
Targets M7a/n_waiting (5.6 waiters) and M7b/clear_lag (5.5 s): default minor-road time gap 1.0 s and moderate minGap, since no feedback yet says the box waiting is off.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M2/early/moto (0.130 share in the last 10 s of red) and M2/first_delay (2.8 s): p equals the observed moto share; cars (0.011) are left out as negligible.

Targets M3/share/moto (0.098), M3/per_cycle (3.9) and M3/var_to_mean (1.14): small base probability plus a mild swarm increment gives an overall share near 0.1 with slight overdispersion; cars excluded (observed 0.004).

Targets F2/p/wrong_lane (0.19-0.23 at q<40 m), F2/p/sidewalk (0.01-0.05), M10b (queue at choice 15 m) and M5/length (15.8 m): trigger near 12 m, green check 7 s from the Viktor example, p_right_lane 0 because it does not exist on this site.
Targets M7a/release_time (2.78 s) and M7b/clear_lag (5.5 s): a moderate extra hold of 1 s on top of SUMO's native release, no feedback yet to move it.
Targets M6 moto approach times (behaviour 10): slow riders stay on the lane centre (offset 0), so they hold up following motorcycles.

reasoning: Prompt gives no feedback from earlier iterations, so I started from near-default SUMO values and moved only parameters with a clear mechanism to an observed metric. Motorcycle packing and filtering (small tau, minGap, minGapLat, compact alignment, lcSublane) target M1/moto 0.30 s, M4 overshoot 0.62 and M5 density; early_start p 0.13 and swarm p0 0.06 follow M2/early/moto 0.130 and M3/share/moto 0.098, with cars left compliant (0.011 and 0.004). Space-seeking uses custom1/custom2 shares of 0.3/0.1 with p_wrong_lane 0.3 and p_sidewalk 0.1 to land near F2 wrong_lane 0.19-0.23, sidewalk 0.01-0.05 and M10a 0.56 per cycle, q=12 m near the observed 15 m queue at choice; p_right_lane is 0 because the prompt says it does not exist on this site. The illegal-left archetype and rule stay near base (release_lag_s 1.0) since M7 offers no signal on which direction to move.
